record_type: disclosure of a blocked first attempt (Phase 7 post-stop mutation rerun)
statement: The first attempt to launch the post-stop mutation rerun never began. The command blocked before execution on a shell step waiting for standard input, so no mutation run started, no log was produced and no result exists from it. That step left POST_STOP_REPAIR_RECORD.json empty; it was then written in full and is preserved unchanged. The four authorized probes had already been added. The rerun was launched afresh.
